notes: Cross-platform deduplication uses canonical_id; titles and platform-specific IDs are not treated as globally unique.
The importer must assign the same canonical_id to the same underlying problem on every platform.
Ratings are kept separate by platform because rating scales are not directly comparable.
Topic solved counts can overlap because a problem may have multiple topic tags.
At least one platform marked its imported data as incomplete or did not explicitly confirm completeness.
